visualCharacteristics: Stacked FAQ panels: each question is a full-width bar with the question text on the left and a plus/minus glyph on the right; clicking expands the answer below. All collapsed by default.
contentPattern: FAQ question/answer list (about 20 items) inside the article column. One row per question: cell 1 question, cell 2 answer.
usage: FAQ pages: a list of questions that expand to show their answers, rendered as native details/summary disclosures.
reuseGuidance: Use for any question/answer or expandable-panel list in article content. Not for tabbed content or navigation.
